key_insight: A consensus-driven stacked ensemble model can predict cardiovascular risk with high accuracy while remaining interpretable through feature selection and SHAP explanations.
clinical_relevance: This framework could support earlier cardiovascular risk stratification and more practical deployment of decision-support tools in clinical settings.
method: Preprocessed 1,529 patient records with 22 features using MICE and outlier removal.
Selected the most informative predictors with a consensus-driven five-feature selection approach.
Tuned and evaluated a stacked ensemble model with GridSearchCV and SHAP interpretation.
evidence_signal: On the future CVD risk score dataset, the optimized stacked ensemble achieved a cross-validated R² of 98.13%, outperforming comparison models in the abstract.
watch_item: Performance is based on a single dataset, so real-world generalizability and workflow integration still need external validation and prospective testing.
paper_title: A Consensus-Driven Stacking Ensemble Framework for Interpretable Cardiovascular Risk Prediction and Clinical Deployment
